pyramiding_rule: Zero pyramiding into active pullbacks; consecutive orders prohibited unless confirmed by multi-timeframe momentum alignment and existing position is deeply in-the-money with break-even stop locked.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Strict volatility-band filter: No entry authorized during ATR expansion spikes unless order book imbalance exceeds 75% in the direction of the trade.
profit_harvest_threshold: Immediate partial scale-out at +$5.00 with trailing stop activation to ensure green runs reach the $15-$30+ asymmetry target.
